Their contributions focus on maintaining modern dependency versions (e.g., migrating `@rollup/plugin-babel` from v5 to v6) and ensuring compatibility in build pipelines. While no direct application code is visible, their work suggests deep familiarity with JavaScript module systems, bundling optimization, and Node.js tooling. This profile aligns with a **Mid-level developer** who likely plays a critical role in build maintenance, dependency hygiene, or infrastructure within a JavaScript project.
